value.title: F258 daemon cost: measure by thread, the inbox poll, next-due cutoff, observer replay (D1 in progress)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Diagnosing CPU without a profiler (no attach on the live daemon):
- proc_pidinfo thread times (Python ctypes: PROC_PIDLISTTHREADS=6, PROC_PIDTHREADINFO=5, user+sys in ns) split the daemon by thread name: tokio-rt-worker, sqlx-sqlite-worker-N, pij-tmux-control. Route active_us is WALL time (lock waits, sqlx hops), not CPU.
- tmux server cost per command: chain N commands in ONE tmux call (`tmux cmd \; cmd ...`), diff /bin/ps time of the server pid, subtract a 10 s baseline. Measured: capture-pane 0.163 ms (18 KB pane), display-message ~0.001 ms.
- Tap activity: stat ~/.pij-rs/pane-signals/*.raw twice 30 s apart. Copilot panes print every 10 s (status line refresh).
- Callers of a route: lsof -iTCP@127.0.0.1:7461 for peers; /v1/cards was chainglass (~/substrate/chainglass, SEATS_TTL_MS 5 s), whoami was the Copilot status line (refreshInterval 10, claude_settings.rs).

Shipped: #310 (A1) made native claim waits event-driven. The R310-F001 lesson: any "next instant after now" read after a claim is a second clock read. Pass the claim's own start (`since`) to the store (`WHERE due > ?3`); never re-read the clock. #312 (B1, migration 48) seats_by_pane: `(?n IS NULL OR col = ?n)` can never use an index, so branch the SQL and use INDEXED BY.

Reviewers want mutant output persisted to files (/tmp/f258-receipts/*.log), quoted in a PR comment; session-only output is not credited.

Under load average 60-160, harness checks fails random untouched tests (pij-tmux control_mode, pij-cli daemon_log or claude_inbound). Run `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` through shared-build plus a rerun of the failing binary alone, and say so in the PR.

D1 IN PROGRESS (branch f258-d1-observer-skip in ~/pi-hacking/pij-f258, uncommitted, first compile was running):
- pane_observer.rs: ObserverCounts in ping (`pane_observer` key), CAPTURE_BACKSTOP 30 s, PaneState.last (composer, cursor, at), replay() and decide() (shared by capture and replay).
- interaction.rs: InteractionGate::observed() -> ObservedComposer; replay only while the gate still holds the cached composer, because a fresh injection capture drains the same tap.
- Existing observer tests script two drains and one capture per tick and will need realistic scripts (tap bytes whenever the screen changes).
- Still to write: tests (a) fresh capture on injection, (b) gate state after replay == after capture over 70 s, via a cfg(test) forget hook, (c) the backstop catches a dead tap, plus tap bytes or a cursor move forcing a capture (FakeTmux needs a cursor setter). Each needs a mutant. Then migration 0049 (live-only partial index; pm-001 assigned it).
